newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA places Sentrachem on rating watch.
newsitem.headline: IBCA places Sentrachem on rating watch.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA said on Thursday it has put the domestic long and short-term ratings of South African chemicals firm Sentrachem Ltd on rating watch with negative implications.
On Wednesday the firm issued a profit warning saying it would post a loss for the first half to February 28 after taking one-off charges worth a total of 261 million rand at its Sanachem unit.

The firm has launched a major restructuring of Sanachem's businesses and will charge 144 million rand after tax and provisions to cover a reduction in Sanachem's product range, the cancelling of registrations of uneconomic products and a review of market conditions.
Another charge of 117 million rand will be taken as a result of unrealistic forward exchange contracts.
IBCA said its concerns were focused on the short-term with the Sanachem problems exacerbating the group's already high gearing, relatively low coverages and negative cash flow.
Sentrachem's domestic short-tem rating is A2 and its long-term rating is A-.
